2. This is an Appeal under section 14-A(2) of the SC & ST (PA) Act, 1989 in assailing an order dated 04.04.2024, passed by the learned Special Judge, Ganjam, Berhampur in G.R. Case No.05 of 2024 running for alleged commission of offence under section 417/376(2)(n)/342/294/323/506 of the IPC read with section 3(1)(r)/3(2)(s)/3(2)(va) of the S.C. & S.T (P.A) Act, 1989.

3. Heard learned counsel for the Appellant, learned counsel for the Informant as well as learned counsel for the State.
4.
Keeping in view the submissions made, the materials as placed including the affidavit of the Respondent No.2 (Informant-Victim) are perused.

5. Considering the submissions made and on going through the materials on record and the surrounding circumstances, further taking into account all such developments which have taken place in the meantime as it reveals from the affidavit of the Respondent No.2 (Informant- victim),
this Court is of the view that further detention of the Appellant till conclusion of the Trial would serve no useful purpose and as such is not warranted.

Accordingly, while being inclined to set aside the impugned order and consider the prayer for grant of bail to the Appellant; it is directed that he be released on bail in the aforesaid case with such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper Chidananda Biswal vs ) State Of Odisha on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98312193/
